presets.name: Golden Hour
presets.prompt: warm low golden-hour sunlight raking in from one side, long soft shadows and a honey-coloured glow on the skin
presets.description: Low warm sun, long shadows, honey glow.

presets.name: Blue Hour
presets.prompt: cool blue-hour twilight with a soft even ambience and a faint warm glow from nearby windows
presets.description: Cool twilight with a faint warm window glow.

presets.name: Overcast Daylight
presets.prompt: soft diffused overcast daylight, with gentle shadows and even skin tones

presets.name: Harsh Midday Sun
presets.prompt: hard overhead midday sunlight, with deep shadows and bright highlights
presets.description: Hard overhead sun with deep shadows.

presets.name: Window Light
presets.prompt: soft directional daylight from a large window, falling across one side of the subject and leaving the other in gentle shadow

presets.name: Rembrandt Lighting
presets.prompt: classic Rembrandt lighting with a single key at forty-five degrees and a small triangle of light on the shadowed cheek
presets.description: Single key with a Rembrandt triangle.

presets.name: Three-Point Setup
presets.prompt: balanced three-point lighting with a soft key, a gentle fill and a crisp rim separating the subject from the background

presets.name: Low-Key Drama
presets.prompt: low-key lighting with a narrow hard key, deep black shadows and only the essential details picked out
presets.description: Narrow key and deep black shadows.

presets.name: High-Key Soft
presets.prompt: bright high-key lighting with large soft sources, minimal shadows and an airy, almost shadowless look

presets.name: Rim Light
presets.prompt: a strong rim light from behind outlining the silhouette, with the front of the subject softly underexposed

presets.name: Neon Practicals
presets.prompt: coloured neon practical lights in magenta and cyan, with wet reflections and deep shadows between them
presets.description: Magenta and cyan neon with wet reflections.

presets.name: Candlelight
presets.prompt: warm flickering candlelight from below and one side, with soft shadows moving across the face

presets.name: Firelight
presets.prompt: orange firelight with a restless flicker, warm highlights and deep surrounding darkness

presets.name: Desk Lamp
presets.prompt: a small warm desk lamp providing a close pool of light, with the rest of the room falling into shadow
presets.description: Close warm pool from a desk lamp.

presets.name: Streetlight
presets.prompt: a single sodium streetlight casting a hard orange pool on wet ground, with the surroundings fading to blue-black
presets.description: Hard orange streetlight on wet ground.

presets.name: Softbox Studio
presets.prompt: large softbox lighting from the front-left, with a clean fill and a subtle catchlight in the eyes
presets.description: Large front-left softbox with clean fill.

presets.name: Beauty Dish
presets.prompt: a beauty dish from slightly above, producing a crisp but flattering light with a gentle falloff

presets.name: Colored Gels
presets.prompt: two coloured gels, warm amber from one side and cool blue from the other, meeting in a soft split across the subject
presets.description: Amber and blue gels in a split setup.

presets.name: Chiaroscuro
presets.prompt: strong chiaroscuro with a single hard source and large areas of near-black shadow
presets.description: Single hard source, large dark shadows.

presets.name: Silhouette
presets.prompt: the subject reduced to a dark silhouette against a bright hazy background, with no detail on the front

presets.name: God Rays
presets.prompt: thick volumetric god rays breaking through dust or haze from high above

presets.name: Underlight
presets.prompt: a hard light source from below, casting unnatural upward shadows across the face
presets.description: Hard light from below with upward shadows.

presets.name: Front Light
presets.prompt: light falling from the front, flattening the face and keeping shadows behind the subject

presets.name: Side Light
presets.prompt: light raking in from one side, revealing texture and leaving the other side in shadow
presets.description: Single side light with deep falloff.

presets.name: Back Light
presets.prompt: light from behind the subject, separating them from the background with a bright edge

presets.name: Three-Quarter Light
presets.prompt: light from a three-quarter angle, modelling one cheek while the other falls softly dark

presets.name: Top Light
presets.prompt: overhead light dropping straight down, shadowing the eyes and emphasising the cheekbones

presets.name: Under Light
presets.prompt: light from below the face, reversing the usual shadows and making the expression unsettling

presets.name: Ambient Wrap
presets.prompt: soft ambient light wrapping evenly around the subject, with almost no directional shadow

presets.name: Practical Glow
presets.prompt: warm practical sources inside the scene, glowing from lamps or windows and falling off into shadow
